overrides.tagline: A sports platform with an Apple-inspired cricket-gear store
overrides.summary: A sports management platform built with React and MongoDB, with an Apple-inspired storefront for cricket gear — bats, gloves, balls, shoes, kit bags, pads and helmets — and a bat trade-in offer.
description: D7 Sports is a sports management platform with real-time updates, built with React for the front end and MongoDB for data storage.

Its storefront borrows Apple's store layout: one clean row of product lines — bats, gloves, balls, shoes, kit bags, pads, helmets — with a trade-in offer that turns old bats into credit toward new ones.

features.title: Product-line row
features.desc: Each category of cricket gear as one scannable row, Apple-store style.

features.title: Trade-in offer
features.desc: Credit toward MRF or SS bats when you trade in an old bat.

features.title: What's new
features.desc: Latest products surfaced on the store page.

features.title: React + MongoDB
features.desc: A React front end on a MongoDB data layer.

challenge: Sports stores tend to be cluttered catalogues. D7 Sports aimed for a calmer, product-first store alongside its sports platform.
